entities.name: Specter
entities.description: A black creature type of vicious undead whose touch numbs minds and steals memories, often riding undead flying mounts.

entities.name: Archons
entities.description: White hooded beings riding flying mounts, mirror-images of specters.

entities.name: Urgoros
entities.description: Dominarian specter that resulted from dementia magic gone wrong.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: Ravnican guild whose mind magic creates specters.

entities.name: Gloamwings
entities.description: Mounts that Ravnican specters create and can reform if killed.

entities.name: Hexhaven
entities.description: Place in the Echoverse of Arcavios where figment specters wander.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: Zendikari continent where specters are native.

relations.note: Ravnican specters are magical creations of the guild
relations.quote: Specters on Ravnica are magical creations of House Dimir
